name: ap-sql-assistant
description: AP-SQL Assistant — Version 11.6. Consolidates every capability introduced from V10.7.1 through V11.5 into one stable, tested build: the V10.7 Multiple Schema Store now additionally supports the V11.1 Stored/Active/Default/Inactive state model (multiple schemas can be Active simultaneously, with a merged view used for SQL generation, Query Builders, and the Error Rectifier — Default's tables win on name collisions); the V10.7.1 Secure GitHub Connection Vault anonymous-read fix, the selectable Schema Synchronization Schedule, and operational password management (with a non-disclosing Forgot Password reset) are all retained and retested; the compact, responsive UI pass (V11.1–V11.3.1) keeps the navbar, Query Builders, and Update Schema screen usable at every viewport width; and the intelligent Describe What You Need engine, structured Query Builder, CR Builder, schema-aware CASE/DECODE, and Error Rectifier are unchanged in behavior from the real, tested V10.7.1 baseline this build was consolidated from.
